prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Katy, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1049; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep to the accident itself, if that's all right.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were driving when the collision happened?
A: I was in Katy, Texas, heading toward a shopping center on the far side of the intersection. I needed to make a left turn into the parking lot.
Q: What was the traffic like at the time?
A: It was fairly steady. The light had gone green for me, and I was waiting for a gap in oncoming cars so I could turn.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: I saw headlights coming toward me, but they seemed far enough away. I started my turn, and then there was a loud bang on the driver's side front.
Q: Where did your vehicle come to rest?
A: Partly in the turn lane and partly in the lane I was turning into. My airbags went off.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. I hit the steering wheel and then tried to brace myself with my left hand. My wrist was badly hurt. I was taken by ambulance and was told it was fractured.
Q: Have you received any treatment since?
A: I've had a cast put on and I'm scheduled for a follow-up with an orthopedic doctor next week. I'm still having trouble gripping things.
Q: Did you speak with anyone at the scene about what happened?
A: Just briefly with the other driver and with the officer who came out. I told the officer what I've told you.
Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was being careful and waiting for a clear path before I moved. I'd like the claim handled as quickly as possible because I can't work with this wrist.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
